asset: Shark PowerDetect stick vacuum - interactive product model
sku: IP1251EUT (working assumption, see PRODUCT_REFERENCE.md and DECISIONS.md)
provenance: Self-authored procedural reconstruction. Generated entirely by scripts/blender/build_powerdetect.py (Blender 5.2.2, headless) from the parameter ledger in scripts/blender/params.py, which traces each dimension to PRODUCT_REFERENCE.md v1.0 / reference images V1-V9 / P1 dimensions. No third-party mesh, scan, CAD, image-to-3D output or purchased asset is included. Reference photographs were used only for measurement and visual comparison and are not shipped.
license: Project-owned original work (procedural geometry, self-generated roller stripe texture). Not a manufacturer CAD model; inferred surfaces (underside, rear brushroll, neck joint internals, handle rear face) are approximations.
accuracy: Reference-matched approximation. Overall envelope matches P1 (H 1.158, W 0.263, D 0.393) within a few mm; component proportions follow PRODUCT_REFERENCE.md. No claim of engineering/CAD accuracy.

branding.decision: No Shark logo, 'POWERDETECT', 'duoclean DETECT' or other lettering is reproduced. Label areas (head label plate, battery label panels, silver 'Shark' band, wand wordmark area, bridge-plate emboss, control screen) are modelled as correctly sized blank or subtly embossed plates.
branding.reason: Brief §7.2: never fake the Shark logo with generated lettering; no properly licensed brand artwork is available. Official artwork can later be applied to the existing blank plates (M_Label / M_HousingDark / M_Silver / M_Screen) with clean UVs.

coordinates.runtime: glTF Y-up; floor y = 0; FloorHead-local +Z = head front
coordinates.authoring: Blender Z-up, head front = Blender -Y; glTF exporter maps Blender (x, y, z) -> glTF (x, z, -y)
coordinates.origin: VacuumRoot at floor level, centred between the front-roller and rear-brushroll contact lines

rig.hierarchy: VacuumRoot > FloorHead > {RollerFront, RollerRear, HeadLights, IntakeFront, IntakeRear, FloorContactAnchors > Contact_*, NeckPivot > LowerWand > FlexPivot > UpperWand > MotorAssembly > {DustbinShell, DustbinContents, PowerControlAnchor}}
rig.meshCarriers: Rig nodes RollerFront, RollerRear, HeadLights, DustbinShell and DustbinContents carry their geometry on a child '<name>_Mesh' node, so mesh quantization never alters the rig node's own transform.
rig.restPose: All rig nodes have identity rotation and unit scale; wand vertical.
rig.pitch: NeckPivot.rotation.x = -pitch leans the wand back (toward -Z); rotation.z = sideways lean
rig.fold: FlexPivot.rotation.x = +fold folds the handheld forward (toward +Z); pivot sits on the front face of the wand top (foldAxisSign = 1 in rig.json)
rig.rollers: Spin about their node's local X axis; geometry centred on the node origin
rig.dustbinContents: Origin at the bin floor; runtime scale.y drives fill (mesh at scale 1 = ~1/3 full)
rig.measurements: public/models/rig.json (nozzle geometry measured from the finished floorhead mesh)

materials.notes: Principled BSDF only (glTF metallic-roughness + KHR transmission/ior/clearcoat). M_RollerFront uses the baked texture assets/source/textures/roller_front.png (1024x512, sRGB, embedded in the GLBs). Colours follow PRODUCT_REFERENCE.md §6 medians (purple #5A3C7E, grey #7D7B76, stripe #429688) and are art-direction estimates.
